question: Do independent official Muntinlupa records corroborate the identity and locality of the BMB 2019 Jamboree Lake row without implying a boundary, current area, or fishing access?
method: Compared the BMB 2019 inventory's printed Jamboree Lake name, lake class, and Muntinlupa City locality with two independent official City Government of Muntinlupa records. The city tourism page places the named lake in the New Bilibid Prisons Reservation Area, Poblacion. Resolution No. 2024-485 separately lists Jamboree Lake with Liberty Statue at the N.B.P. Reservation, Poblacion, Muntinlupa. This corroborates the named-feature/locality relationship for research purposes only. No map, coordinates, boundary, current area, access permission, fish data, or app projection was inferred.

sourceRow.areaDisposition: Historical inventory value only; not adopted as a current measurement, lake extent, or geometry.

independentOfficialSources.title: Jamboree Lake

evidenceUsed.reportedLocality: New Bilibid Prisons Reservation Area, Poblacion

independentOfficialSources.sourceLimits: Official municipal tourism context. It supplies no geospatial boundary, coordinates, current area measurement, fish inventory, fishing permission, or access conditions. The municipal page's smallest-lake superlative was not adopted.

independentOfficialSources.title: Resolution No. 2024-485, authorizing an MOA for maintenance and conservation of cultural and historical landmarks in the NBP Reservation
independentOfficialSources.sourceLimits: Corroborates the named landmark and locality. The resolution is not a lake survey, boundary description, access authorization, fishing regulation, or fisheries record.

crosswalkDecision.confidence: Independent exact-name and locality corroboration from two official city records; no spatial validation.
crosswalkDecision.decision: Treat the BMB row and the municipal Jamboree Lake references as the same named feature for research cross-reference. Keep it out of canonical geometry and public app datasets until lawful, suitable spatial and access evidence is reviewed.

reuseReview.municipalTourismPage: The page footer states City Government of Muntinlupa copyright 2022; no item-specific open-data or republication license was identified. Only attributed factual name/locality notes are retained. No text or photograph is reproduced.
reuseReview.municipalResolution: The official resolution PDF is cited for factual name/locality context; no item-specific reuse license was identified. The PDF is not redistributed.
reuseReview.bmbInventory: The historical BMB row is cited by source and page; no table image or source file is republished.

limitations: Name and locality corroboration does not establish a lake shoreline, coordinates, area, hydrologic connection, or legal boundary.
The BMB 2019 area value is historical and is not evidence of current lake area or shape.
The lake is described within the N.B.P. Reservation; these sources do not establish public entry, fishing access, or permission. Do not infer access from tourism or heritage references.
Neither municipal source supplies a fish survey, taxon observation, water quality measurement, current condition, or safety advisory.
This is a research cross-reference, not a canonical waterbody geometry, completed NCR inventory item, or public-app record. NCR and Luzon coverage remain incomplete.
nextAction: For a future spatial lead, look for a lawfully reusable official or open geospatial source that identifies the lake feature itself; separately verify land-manager access conditions before any fishing-site presentation. Continue the independent locality review for the unnamed Ninoy Aquino Parks and Wildlife Center pond row.
